name: wagon-wheel
description: One VS Code room for your local Claude Code and Codex sessions. Named participants run as private child processes over stdio: no daemon, no open ports.

viewsWelcome.contents:
One room for your local Claude Code and Codex sessions.
[New Room](command:wagonWheel.newRoom)
[Join Existing Conversations](command:wagonWheel.joinExisting)
[Check Setup](command:wagonWheel.checkSetup) · [Report a Problem](command:wagonWheel.reportProblem)
No saved rooms yet. Rooms you create appear here, newest first; click one to reopen it.

wagonWheel.userName.description: Your name as the agents see it. Empty: your first name from git, else your login name.

wagonWheel.cwd.description: Folder the agents work in. Empty: the first workspace folder.

wagonWheel.ideContext.description: Send what you are looking at in VS Code (file, selection, open tabs, problems) with each message.

wagonWheel.showEditorButton.description: Show the Wagon Wheel button (New Room) in the editor title bar, next to other agents' buttons.

wagonWheel.showStatusBar.description: Show the Wagon Wheel button (New Room) in the status bar.

wagonWheel.codexModel.description: Codex model for new rooms, e.g. gpt-6-astra. Empty: your Codex default.

wagonWheel.codexEffort.description: Codex effort for new rooms. Empty: the model's default.

wagonWheel.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI. Empty: the newest one found.

wagonWheel.codexPath.description: Path to the codex CLI. Empty: found automatically.

wagonWheel.experimentalAgents.markdownDescription: EXPERIMENTAL, off by default. Known agents that join rooms over the Agent Client Protocol: `gemini` runs `gemini --experimental-acp` from your PATH. **Wagon Wheel cannot confine such an agent:** it runs its own tools under its own configuration (for Gemini CLI, its sandbox and approval settings). Wagon Wheel only refuses to lend it file or terminal access and rejects the permission requests it sends. Nothing is installed or signed in for you.

enumDescriptions: Claude leads; Codex helps when asked

wagonWheel.defaultTarget.description: Who leads new rooms: messages without an @mention go to the lead.

enumDescriptions: The second agent sees the first answer

wagonWheel.taskMode.description: When agent work becomes a task.

wagonWheel.taskTurns.description: Agent turns allowed per task (both agents, retries included).

wagonWheel.taskReserve.description: Of those, turns kept for wrapping up.

wagonWheel.taskMinutes.description: Active minutes per task. Paused time does not count.
